## 1. Introduction: SGAT Bayesian modelling of GLS positions

After obtaining the raw initial path and correcting the known colony positions (script **03**), this script applies the full **SGAT Bayesian movement model** (Estelle algorithm, MCMC) to each individual trip. The model incorporates:

-   A **twilight error model** (Modified Gamma, then Gamma) to account for sensor noise.
-   **Speed constraints** derived from GPS tracking data for each species and colony.
-   **Fixed positions** at the colony, determined from the colony-days classification (script **02**).
-   A **land mask** to constrain positions to oceanic areas.

The output of this script is a table of modelled positions (`SGAT_trips`) for all GLS, which is used in subsequent scripts for migratory classification (script **04**).

## 2. Load packages and functions

All packages required for this analysis should have been installed in the previous scripts. Here we only need to load them.

```{r loading_packages}
pacman::p_load(
  'readxl', 'readr',           # opening files
  'tidyverse',                   # data management
  'lubridate',                   # dealing with dates
  'GeoLight', 'BAStag', 'TwGeos', 'SGAT',  # geolocator data
  'geosphere',                   # spatial calculations
  'sp', 'sf', 'raster',          # spatial data
  'berryFunctions',              # error checking
  'ggplot2', 'viridis', 'cowplot', 'patchwork' # plots
)
```

We also load our own functions, specifically designed for working with GLS data.

```{r loading_functions}
source('functions/01_FUNCTIONS_GLS_analysis.R')
```

We load the world map for plotting and the land mask for constraining SGAT positions.

```{r load_spatial}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "large", returnclass = "sf")

# Land mask: constrains SGAT positions to oceanic areas
# The shapefile should be available in the project directory
shape <- rgdal::readOGR('input/landmask/landmask_without_delta.shp')
```

## 3. Read metadata and calibration parameters

```{r load_data}
# Metadata updated after trn calculation (script 02) and SGAT initial path (script 03)
mdata3 <- read_csv('input/GLS.files3.csv', col_names = TRUE)
head(mdata3)

# Calibration parameters (from script 01)
calibs    <- read_csv('output/Supervised_calibrations_SGAT.csv')
calib.sum <- read_csv('output/Summary_SGAT_calibrations.csv')

# Colony days (from script 02)
col.days <- read_csv('input/colony_days.csv')

# Colony coordinates
colonies <- read_csv('input/Colony_coordinates.csv')

# Equinox dates per year
equinox <- read_excel('input/Equinox_by_year.xlsx')

# Speed parameters derived from GPS data (per species and colony)
speed.info <- read_csv('input/Speed_parameters.csv')

# Incomplete or problematic trips to handle separately
bad_trips <- read_csv('input/bad_trips.csv')
inc_trips <- bad_trips %>% filter(Problem == 'Incomplete')

# Path to trn files (output from script 02)
trn_path <- 'output/trn/'
```

In this step we add the **colony days** file, which contains the dates each individual was recorded at the colony (no-light days inside the burrow, or nights with \>75% of time in dry/land conditions). These are used to fix known positions during the MCMC modelling.

## 4. SGAT Bayesian modelling

We process all GLS through a loop. For each trip we:

1.  Load the twilight events (`.trn` file) and calibration parameters.
2.  Calculate the optimal **tolerance** (`tol`) for the equinox periods.
3.  Determine the **initial path** (`x0`, `z0`).
4.  Fix colony positions (`fixedx`) using colony-days information.
5.  Define **speed priors** (beta) from GPS-derived speed parameters.
6.  Run the **SGAT MCMC** (two rounds: warming up + final sampling).
7.  Extract and save the **modelled positions** and **density maps**.

### 4.1. Define spatial grid for SGAT density maps

```{r sgat_grid}
xlim  <- c(-90, 50)
ylim  <- c(-50, 50)

# Distribution mask constraining positions to ocean (land = FALSE)
mask2 <- distribution.mask(xlim, ylim, n = 25, shape = shape, land = FALSE)

# log-prior using the land mask
log.prior <- function(p) {
  f <- mask2(p)
  ifelse(f | is.na(f), -Inf, 0)
}
```

### 4.2. Loop over all GLS trips

```{r sgat_loop}
sm.list        <- list()
raw_trips.list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(mdata3)) {
  # i = 1  # for testing

  # ---- 4.2.1. Read GLS information ----------------------------------------
  info     <- mdata3[i, ]
  trn_file <- paste0(trn_path, if_else(!is.na(info$File.trn), info$File.trn, NA_character_))

  # Skip if trn file does not exist
  if (!file.exists(trn_file)) {
    message(paste0('File from ', info$geo_alfanum, ' does not exist - Skipped'))
    next
  }

  # Individual / trip identifiers
  ring     <- info$Ring
  sp       <- info$Sp
  geoID    <- info$geo_alfanum
  geo_trip <- info$geo_trip
  Producer <- info$Producer

  # Colony
  col.name <- info$Colony
  # Harmonise colony name variants
  col.name <- case_when(
    col.name == 'M.Clara'      ~ 'MClara',
    col.name == 'Cala Morell'  ~ 'CalaMorell',
    col.name == 'Curral Velho' ~ 'CVelho',
    col.name == 'Ilheu de Cima'~ 'ICima',
    TRUE                       ~ col.name
  )
  col_lon <- as.numeric(colonies[colonies$Colony == col.name, ]$Lon)
  col_lat <- as.numeric(colonies[colonies$Colony == col.name, ]$Lat)

  # Dates
  year_rec   <- info$Year_rec
  year_dep   <- info$Year_dep
  start_date <- as.Date(info$start_date, tz = 'GMT')
  start_year <- year(start_date)
  end_date   <- as.Date(info$end_date, tz = 'GMT')
  end_year   <- year(end_date)

  # Incomplete trip flag
  inc <- geo_trip %in% inc_trips$geo_trip

  cat(paste0('Processing geo (', i, ') ', geo_trip,
             ' for year ', year_rec, ' from ', col.name, '\n'))

  # ---- 4.2.2. Load twilight events -----------------------------------------
  trn <- read_csv(trn_file, col_names = TRUE, show_col_types = FALSE)
  twl <- trn %>%
    filter(Twilight >= start_date & Twilight <= end_date) %>%
    distinct(Twilight, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(Twilight)

  if (nrow(twl) < 4) {
    message(paste0('Not enough twilight events for ', geoID, ' - Skipped'))
    next
  }

  # ---- 4.2.3. Load calibration parameters ----------------------------------
  # Uses colony/year group mean if individual calibration is missing
  calib.param <- select_sunAngle(producer = Producer, colony = col.name,
                                 year = year_rec, calib.sum, calibs, param = TRUE)
  zenith  <- calib.param$zenith_mean
  zenith0 <- calib.param$zenith0_mean
  alpha   <- calib.param$alpha

  # ---- 4.2.4. Determine tol for equinox correction -------------------------
  Sep_eq <- as.Date(paste0(start_year, '-09-21'))
  Mar_eq <- as.Date(paste0(end_year,   '-03-21'))

  tol_res <- calc_tol(twl, n = 0.001, d = 20,
                      Sep_eq, Mar_eq, k1 = 0.95, k2 = 0.5,
                      plot = FALSE)

  # ---- 4.2.5. Compute initial path (x0, z0) --------------------------------
  if (!is.null(tol_res$tol_mar)) {
    # Two-part path: different tol for September and March equinoxes
    twl_1 <- twl %>% filter(Twilight >= start_date & Twilight <= paste0(end_year, '-01-01'))
    twl_2 <- twl %>% filter(Twilight >  paste0(end_year, '-01-01') & Twilight <= end_date)

    path_1 <- thresholdPath(twl_1$Twilight, twl_1$Rise, zenith = zenith, tol = tol_res$tol_sep)
    path_2 <- thresholdPath(twl_2$Twilight, twl_2$Rise, zenith = zenith, tol = tol_res$tol_mar)

    x0   <- rbind(path_1$x, path_2$x)
    time <- c(path_1$time, path_2$time)
  } else {
    path <- thresholdPath(twl$Twilight, twl$Rise, zenith = zenith, tol = tol_res$tol_sep)
    x0   <- path$x
    time <- path$time
  }

  z0 <- trackMidpts(x0)

  cat('Initial path determined\n')

  # Plot raw path
  raw_map <- plot_SGAT(x0, time, d = 20, Sep_eq, Mar_eq, world, col_lat, col_lon) +
    labs(title = paste0(geo_trip, ' — raw path'))

  # Save raw positions
  raw.points <- cbind(time, x0)
  colnames(raw.points) <- c('Date_Time', 'lon', 'lat')
  raw.points <- bind_cols(
    Ring = ring, Species = sp, Colony = col.name, geoID = geoID,
    geo_trip = geo_trip, Producer = Producer,
    start_year = start_year, end_year = end_year,
    tol_sep = tol_res$tol_sep, tol_mar = tol_res$tol_mar,
    as.data.frame(raw.points)
  )
  raw_trips.list[[i]] <- raw.points

  # ---- 4.2.6. Fix colony-day positions (fixedx) ----------------------------
  cdays <- col.days %>%
    dplyr::filter(geo_trip == .env$geo_trip) %>%
    filter(light == TRUE | wetdry == TRUE)

  auxi <- data.frame(date = as.Date(time))
  auxi <- cbind(auxi, as.data.frame(x0), row = row_number(auxi))
  auxi <- auxi %>% filter(date %in% cdays$date)
  auxi <- left_join(auxi, cdays[, c(3, 6, 9)], by = 'date')

  # fixedx codes: 1 = light colony day (exact colony), 2 = wetdry colony day
  # (random point within 100 km), 0 = free
  fixedx <- rep(0, nrow(x0))
  fixedx[auxi[is.na(auxi$wetdry), ]$row]      <- 3
  fixedx[auxi[auxi$wetdry == TRUE, ]$row]      <- 2
  fixedx[auxi[auxi$light  == TRUE, ]$row]      <- 1
  fixedx[1:2] <- 1  # first two positions fixed at colony

  # Last positions: fixed only if the GLS was recovered at colony (not resuscitated)
  if (end_date == as.Date(twl$Twilight[nrow(twl)])) {
    fixedx[(nrow(x0) - 1):nrow(x0)] <- 1
  } else {
    fixedx[(nrow(x0) - 1):nrow(x0)] <- 0
  }

  # Assign colony coordinates to fixed positions
  for (k in which(fixedx != 0)) {
    code <- fixedx[k]
    if (code == 1) {
      x0[k, 1] <- col_lon
      x0[k, 2] <- col_lat
    } else if (code == 2) {
      random_p <- geosphere::destPoint(p = c(col_lon, col_lat),
                                       b = runif(1, 0, 360), d = 100 * 1000)
      x0[k, 1] <- as.numeric(random_p[1])
      x0[k, 2] <- as.numeric(random_p[2])
    }
  }

  # Convert fixedx to logical (TRUE/FALSE) as required by SGAT
  fixedx_logical <- fixedx == 1

  z0 <- trackMidpts(x0)  # update midpoints after fixing colony positions

  # Plot colony-corrected path
  cdays_map <- plot_SGAT(x0, time, d = 20, Sep_eq, Mar_eq, world, col_lat, col_lon) +
    labs(title = paste0(geo_trip, ' — colony days corrected'))

  cat('Colony days corrected\n')

  # ---- 4.2.7. Speed prior (beta) from GPS data -----------------------------
  if (col.name == 'Raso') {
    speed <- speed.info %>% filter(Species == sp & Colony != 'MClara')
    beta  <- parametersGamma(mean(speed$mean2_ind), mean(speed$sd2_ind))
  } else if (col.name == 'MClara' & sp == 'CALEDW') {
    speed <- speed.info %>% filter(Species == sp & Colony == col.name & Behaviour == 'All')
    beta  <- parametersGamma(speed$mean2_ind_year, speed$sd2_ind_year)
  } else {
    speed <- speed.info %>% filter(Species == sp & Colony == col.name & Behaviour == 'All')
    beta  <- parametersGamma(speed$mean2_ind, speed$sd2_ind)
  }

  # ---- 4.2.8. SGAT MCMC: Round 1 (warming up, ModifiedGamma) --------------
  twl <- twl[order(as.POSIXct(as.character(twl$Twilight),
                               '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', tz = 'GMT')), ]

  model <- thresholdModel(
    twilight       = twl$Twilight,
    rise           = twl$Rise,
    twilight.model = 'ModifiedGamma',
    alpha          = alpha,
    beta           = beta,
    x0             = x0,
    z0             = z0,
    zenith         = zenith0,
    logp.x         = log.prior,
    logp.z         = log.prior,
    fixedx         = fixedx_logical
  )

  x.proposal <- mvnorm(S = diag(c(0.0025, 0.0025)), n = nlocation(x0))
  z.proposal <- mvnorm(S = diag(c(0.0025, 0.0025)), n = nlocation(z0))

  fit <- estelleMetropolis(model, x.proposal, z.proposal, iters = 1000, thin = 20)

  # Update starting positions from round 1
  x0 <- chainLast(fit$x)
  z0 <- chainLast(fit$z)

  # ---- 4.2.9. SGAT MCMC: Round 2 (tuning proposals, Gamma) ----------------
  model <- thresholdModel(
    twilight       = twl$Twilight,
    rise           = twl$Rise,
    twilight.model = 'Gamma',
    alpha          = alpha,
    beta           = beta,
    x0             = x0,
    z0             = z0,
    zenith         = zenith0,
    logp.x         = log.prior,
    logp.z         = log.prior,
    fixedx         = fixedx_logical
  )

  x.proposal <- mvnorm(S = diag(c(0.005, 0.005)), n = nrow(twl))
  z.proposal <- mvnorm(S = diag(c(0.005, 0.005)), n = nrow(twl) - 1)

  # Three tuning iterations to adapt proposal covariance
  round2 <- try(for (k in 1:3) {
    fit <- estelleMetropolis(model, x.proposal, z.proposal,
                             x0 = chainLast(fit$x), z0 = chainLast(fit$z),
                             iters = 300, thin = 20)
    if (is.error(fit)) next
    x.proposal <- mvnorm(chainCov(fit$x), s = 0.2)
    z.proposal <- mvnorm(chainCov(fit$z), s = 0.2)
  })

  if (is.error(round2)) {
    message(paste0('MCMC tuning failed for ', geo_trip, ' - Skipped'))
    next
  }

  # ---- 4.2.10. SGAT MCMC: Final run ----------------------------------------
  x.proposal <- mvnorm(chainCov(fit$x), s = 0.25)
  z.proposal <- mvnorm(chainCov(fit$z), s = 0.25)

  fit <- estelleMetropolis(model, x.proposal, z.proposal,
                           x0 = chainLast(fit$x), z0 = chainLast(fit$z),
                           iters = 4000, thin = 20, chain = 1)

  cat('MCMC modelling done\n')

  # ---- 4.2.11. Extract modelled positions ----------------------------------
  sm <- locationSummary(fit$z, time = fit$model$time)
  sm <- sm %>%
    mutate(
      Date_Time = Time1,
      lon       = Lon.mean,
      lat       = Lat.mean,
      month     = month(Time1, label = TRUE),
      equinox   = ifelse(
        (Time1 >= as.POSIXct(as.Date(Sep_eq) - 25) & Time1 <= as.POSIXct(as.Date(Sep_eq) + 25)) |
          (Time1 >= as.POSIXct(as.Date(Mar_eq) - 25) & Time1 <= as.POSIXct(as.Date(Mar_eq) + 25)),
        'Equinox', 'Not equinox'
      )
    )

  sm <- bind_cols(
    Ring = ring, Species = sp, Colony = col.name, geoID = geoID,
    geo_trip = geo_trip, Producer = Producer,
    start_year = start_year, end_year = end_year,
    tol_sep = tol_res$tol_sep, tol_mar = tol_res$tol_mar,
    sm
  )

  sm.list[[i]] <- sm

  # ---- 4.2.12. Density raster and SGAT map --------------------------------
  r <- raster(
    nrows = 25 * diff(ylim), ncols = 25 * diff(xlim),
    xmn = xlim[1] - 5, xmx = xlim[2] + 5,
    ymn = ylim[1] - 5, ymx = ylim[2] + 5
  )

  s  <- slices(type = 'intermediate', mcmc = fit, grid = r)
  sk <- slice(s, sliceIndices(s))

  r_df <- as.data.frame(sk, xy = TRUE)

  SGAT_map <- ggplot() +
    geom_raster(data = r_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = layer), alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_viridis(name = 'SGAT density', option = 'C',
                       direction = -1, na.value = 'white') +
    geom_sf(data = world, fill = grey(0.9), color = grey(0.6), lwd = 0.2) +
    geom_point(aes(x = col_lon, y = col_lat), shape = 8, size = 2.5, color = 'black') +
    geom_path(data = sm, aes(x = Lon.mean, y = Lat.mean),
              color = adjustcolor('darkgrey', alpha.f = 0.6),
              linetype = 'solid', linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(data = sm, aes(x = Lon.mean, y = Lat.mean, color = month), shape = 19) +
    coord_sf(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste0(geo_trip, ' — SGAT model')) +
    xlab('Longitude') + ylab('Latitude') +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid   = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = 'black', fill = NA),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 14)
    )

  # ---- 4.2.13. Save plots --------------------------------------------------
  if (!dir.exists('output/plots/SGAT')) {
    dir.create('output/plots/SGAT', recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }

  # Individual SGAT density map
  ggsave(
    plot     = SGAT_map,
    filename = paste0('output/plots/SGAT/', geo_trip, '_', year_rec, '_',
                      sp, '_', col.name, '_SGAT.jpg'),
    width = 15, height = 12
  )

  # Combined panel: raw path | colony-corrected | SGAT model
  p_combined <- plot_grid((raw_map | cdays_map) / SGAT_map)

  ggsave(
    plot     = p_combined,
    filename = paste0('output/plots/SGAT/', geo_trip, '_', year_rec, '_',
                      sp, '_', col.name, '_SGAT_panel.jpg'),
    width = 15, height = 18
  )

  cat('Plots saved\n')
}
```

## 5. Save SGAT modelled tracks

After running the full loop, we join all individual results and save the final output files.

```{r save_outputs}
# Join raw initial paths
raw_trips <- plyr::ldply(raw_trips.list, data.frame)

# Join SGAT modelled positions
SGAT_trips <- plyr::ldply(sm.list, data.frame)

# Save outputs
write_csv(raw_trips,  'output/Raw_SGAT_tracks_tol.csv')
write_csv(SGAT_trips, 'output/SGAT_modelled_tracks.csv')

# Update metadata file: mark which GLS have been modelled
mdata3 <- mdata3 %>%
  mutate(SGAT = ifelse(geo_trip %in% SGAT_trips$geo_trip, 'Yes', 'No'))

write_csv(mdata3, file = 'input/GLS.files4.csv')

cat('All outputs saved\n')
cat(paste0('Total trips modelled: ', n_distinct(SGAT_trips$geo_trip), '\n'))
```

## 6. Quick overview of modelled tracks

A brief summary plot to visually inspect all modelled tracks before moving to the migratory classification (script **04**).

```{r overview_plot}
SGAT_trips_sf <- SGAT_trips %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lon) & !is.na(lat)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(lon > -180 & lon < 180 & lat > -90 & lat < 90)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world, fill = grey(0.9), color = grey(0.6), lwd = 0.2) +
  geom_point(data = SGAT_trips_sf, aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = Colony),
             size = 0.3, alpha = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = TRUE) +
  labs(title = 'All SGAT modelled tracks', x = 'Longitude', y = 'Latitude') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = 'black', fill = NA),
    legend.position = 'bottom'
  )
```
